title: Payment processor interface with a fake Stripe so billing is built and specified before an account exists
description:
Stripe work starts now, with no Stripe account. Everything that talks to Stripe goes through one interface, and every spec runs against an in-memory fake that mirrors Stripe's documented object shapes and webhook events.

Feature: Payment processor boundary
  Scenario: No network in specs
    Given the test suite
    When billing specs run
    Then no HTTPS call leaves the process and no Stripe key is read
  Scenario: Fake mirrors Stripe shapes
    Given the fake processor
    When a customer, subscription, invoice and payment intent are created
    Then ids use Stripe prefixes (cus_, sub_, in_, pi_, evt_), amounts are integer minor units, and statuses follow Stripe's lifecycle (subscription incomplete, active, past_due, canceled; invoice draft, open, paid, void, uncollectible)
  Scenario: Webhook signature
    Given a signing secret generated in the test
    When a payload is signed with Stripe's v1 scheme and a tolerance of 300 seconds
    Then a valid signature is accepted once, a replayed event id is a no-op, a tampered payload and a stale timestamp are refused with 400 and nothing is written
  Scenario: Switching to real Stripe
    Given STRIPE mode test and parameters present
    When the processor is constructed
    Then the Stripe implementation is used with the restricted key, and a missing or short parameter fails closed with 503 billing_unavailable

Done looks like: `billing/processor.ts` (interface), `billing/stripe-processor.ts` (real, thin, no secret logging), `billing/testing/fake-stripe.ts`, `billing/webhook-signature.ts`; a `billing/deployment.json` flag (`stripe: { enabled: false, mode: "test" }`, committed disabled) in the style of `accounts/anthus-one-deployment.json`. The Stripe SDK dependency is pinned; the fake does not import it.

Data touched: none persistent; parameters named but not created: `/prospectus/billing/stripe/secret-key/v1`, `/prospectus/billing/stripe/webhook-secret/v1` (SSM SecureString, created by Ryan in the Stripe account task, never by CDK or the repository).

Specs: `features/billing-stripe.feature`; `billing/webhook-signature.test.ts`, `billing/fake-stripe.test.ts`; a test that scans captured console output for key material.
